objective: Implement the fixed-height dense row view and the deterministic-row evidence grid against VisibleProjectIds, preserving URL state, focus, and scroll position across view switches.
prohibitedChanges: No per-card observers, listeners, or animation controllers (PRD 9.3)
No measuring every card - row geometry is computed from width and tokens
No independent filter state - views consume VisibleProjectIds only
deliverables: Fixed-height row view with stable project-id keys and overscan of 6
Scroll and focus restoration across view switch and back/forward
Paginated semantic fallback of 50 projects per page
acceptance: Mounted cards within MOUNTED-CARDS-MAX and rows within MOUNTED-ROWS-MAX
Archive DOM within DOM-ARCHIVE-STEADY and never above DOM-ARCHIVE-CEILING
Zero forced synchronous layouts during scroll
No task over 50 ms during search or filter
aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex expose position; the semantic fallback is reachable
